title: Noe Business Quest

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Well. I suppose you're the entrepreneur Agent T-Let's-Go was talking about. Sorry to say it, but you don't look the type.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well. I suppose you're the entrepreneur Agent T-Let's-Go was talking about. Sorry to say it, but you don't look the type.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Too bad you won't find either of those things here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad you won't find either of those things here.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Oh, you know. A LICCY hound.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you know. A LICCY hound.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: That's true of all of us, darling.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's true of all of us, darling.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: I remember the days when you couldn’t see the floor for stardust. We would drink Tarragon Phantoms and Java Blasts until the sun melted into the moon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember the days when you couldn’t see the floor for stardust. We would drink Tarragon Phantoms and Java Blasts until the sun melted into the moon.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: It was the most gorgeous, sinful, glorious dive bar in all Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was the most gorgeous, sinful, glorious dive bar in all Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: It was a shithole, darling. The ceiling was held up with grav-tape and the steam pipes leaked, but we covered all that in holo-paint and danced in the puddles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was a shithole, darling. The ceiling was held up with grav-tape and the steam pipes leaked, but we covered all that in holo-paint and danced in the puddles.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: What always happens. The party ended. My clientele found some other spot and left me to foot the bill. See that club over there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What always happens. The party ended. My clientele found some other spot and left me to foot the bill. See that club over there?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Oh, I won't give my license to just anyone. They would have to be the right kind of person. Scrappy, yet soulful. Eager, yet poised...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I won't give my license to just anyone. They would have to be the right kind of person. Scrappy, yet soulful. Eager, yet poised...

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: I suppose you're right. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm supposed to be drowning my sorrows, and right now I'm only paddling in the blues. Chin chin, darling.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suppose you're right. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm supposed to be drowning my sorrows, and right now I'm only paddling in the blues. Chin chin, darling.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: You are sweet. And perhaps you’re right. I'll drink on it. Chin chin, darling.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are sweet. And perhaps you’re right. I'll drink on it. Chin chin, darling.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: With what, sweetie? The last time I checked, you couldn’t pay rent with shimmering wit and a flawless vintage ensemble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With what, sweetie? The last time I checked, you couldn’t pay rent with shimmering wit and a flawless vintage ensemble.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: WAS my bar. The Lowtown Lily. It doesn't look it, but once upon a time this place was one big party.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: WAS my bar. The Lowtown Lily. It doesn't look it, but once upon a time this place was one big party.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Mhhmm. Well, then you should know we used to serve a signature cocktail here. I call it a "Frosted Murder". Find the ingredients, bring them back, and I'll know you can handle the business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhhmm. Well, then you should know we used to serve a signature cocktail here. I call it a "Frosted Murder". Find the ingredients, bring them back, and I'll know you can handle the business.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Vodka, liquid nitrogen and cherries. Simple, yet deadly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Vodka, liquid nitrogen and cherries. Simple, yet deadly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What type?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What type?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm party on the outside, business on the inside.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm party on the outside, business on the inside.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm party on the outside, business on the inside.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm party on the outside, business on the inside.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm here because I have to be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm here because I have to be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm here because I have to be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm here because I have to be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds glamorous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds glamorous.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're need someone to take over your Tier 2 license?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're need someone to take over your Tier 2 license?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're need someone to take over your Tier 2 license?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're need someone to take over your Tier 2 license?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All good things come to an end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All good things come to an end.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All good things come to an end.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All good things come to an end.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this your bar?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this your bar?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am ALL of those things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am ALL of those things.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I am ALL of those things.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I am ALL of those things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could be... some of those things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could be... some of those things.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could be... some of those things.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could be... some of those things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No problemo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problemo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do? Will you open a new bar?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do? Will you open a new bar?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What will you do? Will you open a new bar?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What will you do? Will you open a new bar?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's in a Frosted Murder?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's in a Frosted Murder?
